seo.title: About Northwind: a small studio for the web
seo.description: Meet Northwind, a small studio that builds fast, editable websites and helps teams take full ownership of their content.

props.heading: About us
props.subheading: A small studio that believes websites should be easy to run.

props.content:
Our story

Northwind started in 2019 with a simple frustration: every small copy change needed a developer. We set out to build sites that editors can safely change on their own.

Today we are a team of eleven designers, engineers and editors working with companies across Europe. We care about speed, accessibility and clear writing.

What guides our work:

  • Content comes first, design follows
  • Every page loads fast on every device
  • Editors own the site, not the other way round

props.heading: The people behind Northwind
props.body: We work in small, senior teams. The person you meet at the kickoff is the one who ships your site.

props.heading: Want to work together?
props.text: We take on a few new projects every quarter.
